title: Integrate website illustrations and content into a unified manuscript composition
outcome: Integrate website illustrations and content into a unified manuscript composition
acceptance: All three folios preserve responsive navigation, readable content, and accessible controls
Required repository gates and focused browser checks pass
The left studies, central content, and right studies maintain a cohesive layout at desktop and ultrawide widths

completion.summary: Integrated the left, center, and right artwork into a centered composition with bounded spacing, shared ink treatment, overlapping fades behind readable content, and navigation that follows the page width. Updated layout styles and design documentation. All nine required repository gates, existing browser checks, desktop/mobile accessibility scans, JavaScript syntax, and diff checks passed. Visually checked all three folios through 3440-pixel ultrawide layouts and phone screens.
